findings.note: The symbol a is already the constant in t = ax² + bx, so this line reads as an equation in a, a = −2av³, which would give 1 = −2v³. The result is right but the printed line is inconsistent with the question's own notation.

notes: dt/dx = 2ax + b, v = 1/(2ax + b), dv/dx = −2a/(2ax + b)² = −2av², acceleration = v dv/dx = −2av³. Both non-distractor entries land exactly where they claim: dt/dx miswritten as a + 2bx with the sign dropped gives 2bv³ (option 2), and taking dv/dx itself as the acceleration with the sign dropped gives 2av² (option 4), which is the option built up to sign for that slip. I could find no route producing the mixed ab combination of option 1, so its distractor flag stands; it is also the only one of the four that does not match the dimensions of the other three.
